headline: Fourteenth Day Finds Dead Lands Still Bleeding as Fronts Widen
war_summary: The guns have not slackened since our last edition. The Dead Lands remain the war's bloodiest ledger, with casualties now past eight thousand nine hundred Colonial and ten thousand one hundred Warden names, and the hourly toll still climbing; fourteen base events stand logged there across the day, Sun's Hollow and Liberation Point the busiest posts, the score standing six Wardens to five Colonials. Endless Shore leads all regions with forty-two recorded base events around Woodbind, Saltbrook Channel and Wellchurch, though its latest entry came some hours ago and the front there has since gone quiet on recent readings. Drowned Vale has roared back to life after a lull, seven events inside two hours at Eastmarch and The Wash, leaving eleven bases Colonial to one Warden. Fresh movement shows at Stema Landing, where five events struck within the past two hours at The Wane, and The Fingers continue to bleed heavily with fresh Colonial gains. Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties without a single base event, pressure without recorded movement. By contrast, Kings Cage, Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm have cooled markedly in recent hours, while rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors. Thirty-four victory towns are required; none has yet fallen.
